messages:
maya: quick night-shift handoff — what I did / blockers / today
maya: what I did: noticed a sharp P95 latency spike for the dedicated-eu pool after several node preemption events around 02:10 UTC. spun up a canary routing to fallback-model-v2 to keep latency under SLO.
maya: blockers: cloud preemptions causing pods to be evicted and long KV-cache warmups; regen requests intermittently returning 503 while pods come up. metric noise on autoscaler makes it slow to react.
maya: mitigations applied: routing override -> route 30% eu traffic to fallback-model-v2; increased replica count on fallback deployment; temporarily lowered preemption priority for dedicated nodes in eu-central. created incident ticket INC-2026-0454.
maya: quick note: logs show evictions + kube reschedule loops, example: ```kubectl get pods -n dedicated | grep eu-central``` returned multiple `Evicted` states then `CrashLoopBackOff` for ~3 pods.
aj: thanks — can you paste the exact routing update command so I can validate and escalate if needed? also tagging infra: @kevin
maya: ticket INC-2026-0454 in ops. routing command I used (internal API): ```curl -X POST https://internal-console.redwood/api/v1/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"region":"eu-central","policy":"fallback","weight":30}'``` — runbook step 3 has full revert steps.
aj: ok I'll mirror that locally. setting an alert to page if P95 > SLO for >3 min. pinging @kevin for infra actions. :eyes: 
kevin: looking now. I increased managed node pool size by +2 and tainted spot nodes so critical pods prefer non-preemptible. command I ran: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize dedicated-eu-pool --size=12``` — nodes are provisioning.
ops-bot: rollback executed rb-20260317-01 (initiated by maya) — deploy-bot logs: rollback completed, traffic stable on fallback route.
sasha: adding follow-up: create a small test to reproduce autoscaler churn under preemption and add mitigation notes to infra backlog. assigned to infra-team, priority P2.
maya: next steps for oncall: monitor P95 and error rate for 30m; if regen errors >1% for 5m escalate to infra with INC-2026-0454; prepare to shift to full fallback-model-v2 if latency doesn't recover. left detailed notes in the incident ticket. handing off to aj. :thumbsup:
aj: taking over. plan: 1) watch metrics and logs, 2) run `kubectl describe` on any new Evicted pods to capture node events, 3) if autoscaler oscillates, force scale to stable size and file postmortem. I'll update INC-2026-0454 with any changes.
kevin: will keep an eye on node provisioning and spot tainting. if we still see evictions after new nodes are ready I'll open a deep-dive.
maya: thanks everyone — signing off. ping me if you need me back in. :pray:
